_comment: The playoff analyst (docs/channel.md §30.2; mock-ups on analyst.html; loaded and validated by src/config.js, said by src/channel/analystTalk.js, voiced by npm run voices -- --analyst). The PLAYOFF PREVIEW show's desk bits: THE FOUR after THE TABLE'S STORY, and one per semifinal before its TALE OF THE TAPE. Tom's pick (2026-10-17): Radomir Brodek (Krenn until 2026-10-18), in Hedrek's seat on the left; Ysolde hosts from her seat on the right, in her own voice, asking; the analyst answers. As data/studio.json's lines: each kind has who says it (host or analyst), a gesture, when it's said (the fact that makes it true, in 'when', worked out by the build), and ways, each a pair: say (spoken and typed in the bubble: fixed, or naming one team as {team}, one clip per team) and show (the graphic under the speaker: any facts, in capitals). Players are named on the graphics only, not spoken (a new voice would need a clip per surname, and every draft brings new ones).
